text:
Only thirst
+
+silence
+
+no encounter
+
+
+beware of me my love
+
+beware of the silent woman in the desert
+
+of the traveler with the empty glass
+
+and of the shadow of her shadow

translation.editorial_note: The warning remains unpunctuated and turns the speaker into three receding figures: silent woman, empty-handed traveler, and doubled shadow.
